usage:
Usage: cleared run "<task>" [--service <name>] [--template bug|review|ci|question] [--wait]
Makes a ticket of the task and starts it as you, with the API token of your menu in the app, read from the file CLEARED_V2_API_TOKEN_FILE names (mode 600) or from CLEARED_V2_API_TOKEN.
With --wait, follows it to its approval, which stays yours, in the app.
one_task: One task at a time: put the whole task in quotes.
unknown_option: {option} is not an option of cleared run.
unknown_template: "{template}" is not a template. The templates: {list}.
no_credential: No API token: make one in the app (your menu, API access), save it in a file only you can read, and name the file in CLEARED_V2_API_TOKEN_FILE.
credential_open: Other accounts can read {path}. Run chmod 600 {path}, then the command again.
unreachable: The service does not answer at {address}. Is Cleared started on this machine?
unavailable: The service cannot run tickets yet: {reason}
refused_credential: The service refused the API token: it was revoked, or it is not one of this service. Make another in the app.
refused_person: The API token belongs to an account this service no longer has.
queued_lanes: {ticket} waits for a lane: {running} of {lanes} running.
queued_week: {ticket} waits: the seven-day window is at {percent}%, and tickets stop at {stop}%.
queued_five_hours: {ticket} waits: the five-hour window is at {percent}%, and tickets stop at {stop}%.
approval: {ticket} waits for your approval in the app's Inbox. Time taken: {time}.
approved: {ticket} is approved and being merged. Time taken: {time}.
